remarks: Charming 1925 colonial conveniently located walking distance to town and train. Gleaming hardwood floors and large windows welcome you to this 4 bedroom/2 bath, well-loved home. The first floor includes the kitchen, on open flow, sun-drenched dining room and living room with custom inlaid floors, as well as the primary bedroom and bath. Upstairs is an additional bath plus 3 bedrooms, one of which would make a great nursery or home office. The lower level consists of a recreation room with wall to wall carpeting and a walkout basement which provides excellent storage space and includes a washer, dyer and freezer. Interior and exterior recently painted. A large deck in back offers opportunities to grill, relax or entertain while enjoying the spacious, level backyard.
